people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,
translations.bsb: You are to dwell in booths for seven days. All the native-born of Israel must dwell in booths,
